subject: Verify Candidate 01 Page 2 right geometry
body: Verify commit 8ef02b0e327cbaabb13a8153b2409c81f1e637cf through the A2A Execution Plane. PASS only if the branch contains the exact right-side bbox fix, left-side Page 2 geometry is untouched by PAGE2_ASSEMBLY_FIX, Python compiles, and the target commit is present.
